title: About Me
text:
About Me
My name is Yifan Cui, and I am currently pursuing a Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University.
I previously earned a bachelor’s degree in Mathematics and Business Administration from Northeastern University. My academic background has helped me build a strong foundation in quantitative reasoning, business analysis, and data-driven decision-making.
My interests include:

Business Analytics
Data Analytics
Data Visualization
Machine Learning
Business Intelligence

I enjoy using data to identify patterns, solve problems, and communicate insights clearly. Through my coursework and projects, I have worked with tools such as Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, and GitHub.
My career goal is to work in data analytics, business intelligence, or applied analytics, where I can combine technical skills with business knowledge to support better decisions.
